topology: Pi Zero W -> SC0727 -> USB-A coupling -> Adafruit4472 -> torso OpenRB; no external Mac shortcut.

finiteFindings.scope: Named source solids plus current Pi/audio, IMU, carrier and plug receiving geometry. Original uncut body shells conservatively supersede cut-only U-notch; any shell hit remains a candidate failure requiring actual-notch localization.

finiteFindings.lengthAccounting: Manufacturer4472 A mould+relief22.9mm plus assumed SC female25mm. Exposed male metal inserts inside the female; it is not included twice. Do not subtract insertion from plastic lengths.
finiteFindings.limits: This conservative receiving-box failure is not proof that the unmeasured actual female mould cannot fit. No smaller shape was invented.

allHeadInternalCouplerNecessaryBound.condition: A flexible cable tail remains inside the existing head, no lower than the original head-bottom minimumZ. The coupler is fixed to the head.
allHeadInternalCouplerNecessaryBound.result: REJECTED under this tested pose and head-fixed-coupler condition. No route optimizer or bend assumption is needed.
allHeadInternalCouplerNecessaryBound.doesNotClaim: Does not certify physical availability of all XML poses, disprove every movable/intermediate coupling topology, or authorize shortening the joint range.

assemblySequenceIfLaterRevised: Bench-seat Micro-B at Pi while the cap is open; do not force an A mould through the curved head floor.
Thread the unjoined USB-A cable end through a proved open neck route before mounting/closing surrounding structural parts.
Join USB-A male/female at an accessible location; provide a supported coupling whose moving-body ownership is explicit.
Seat USB-C at the torso OpenRB before closing the cut-only original-width body; keep the local carrier assembly sequence.
Check continuous motion with actual available soft lengths before fixing strain relief. These steps are a dependency plan, not an accepted insertion path.
decision: Do not adopt the torso-board proposal based on the local carrier positive alone. With a head-fixed A coupling, this purchased4472 is too short for the stated native-clear witness. A changed cable or a demonstrably suitable intermediate moving coupling would be a separate architecture decision; no purchase or change is made here.
